instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot, eye-level. In an indoor martial arts studio, the man in the white gi (R1) on the left is kneeling and leaning forward, pushing down on the arm of the man in the gray gi (R2). The man in the gray gi (R2) on the right is sitting on the mat, leaning back to defend. They grapple on a black mat under warm indoor lighting.
elements: R1 pushes down on R2's arm
R2 leans back to defend against R1's pressure
R1 kneels and leans forward while R2 sits on the mat
R1 and R2 grapple with contact on the mat
